_note: 案例证据字段（Growth OS 计划 §3 案例页要求）。每条只用页面已陈述的事实；缺的写 Not published，不补编。

bus-depot-czechia.site_context: Czech bus station operated by a scheduled-service company; the timetable peak (06:40 departure) is the binding event, not daily kWh.
bus-depot-czechia.binding_constraint: Morning peak: twelve buses must leave at once. Sizing for the average day would have under-sized the site; sizing each bus for its own peak would have required a larger grid connection.
bus-depot-czechia.configuration: 12 × dual-gun 120 kW DC chargers → 24 DC connectors from 12 supplies. Ordered May 2026, energised July 2026.
bus-depot-czechia.outcome: The morning peak is cleared without paying for a grid upgrade; peak is met by sharing power across dispensers rather than by adding capacity.
bus-depot-czechia.limits: Single site, single operator, one timetable season. Figures are the ordered configuration and the operator's operating pattern — not an independently audited throughput study.
bus-depot-czechia.source: Project configuration as delivered; operating pattern supplied by the operator.

jordan-160kw.site_context: Highway corridor charging built with a leading Middle East CPO, in a summer climate that exceeds 45 °C.
jordan-160kw.binding_constraint: Heat: ambient above 45 °C for sustained periods is what limits output on corridor sites, because the enclosure has no forced cooling beyond what the design provides.
jordan-160kw.configuration: Vulco DC Series at 160 kW, in dual-gun and three-gun configurations (2 × and 3 × connectors per cabinet).
jordan-160kw.commissioning: Site commissioned with the partner CPO; the completed station is one of the largest charging sites in Jordan.
jordan-160kw.outcome: Rated output is held through summer operation above 45 °C; the site ranks among the largest charging stations in the country.
jordan-160kw.limits: Per-site observation at one power rating — it does not establish a derating curve and says nothing about a 360 kW cabinet in the same air.
jordan-160kw.source: Deployment record; operating conditions from the site.

cambodia-240kw.site_context: Phnom Penh charging operator on Cambodia's national highway, returning after an earlier Vulco deployment.
cambodia-240kw.binding_constraint: Monsoon season plus a limited grid, with zero tolerance for downtime at a site the operator had already committed to.
cambodia-240kw.configuration: 3 × Pales DC Series: 2 × 180 kW + 1 × 240 kW, dual-gun GB/T.
cambodia-240kw.commissioning: Second deployment for the same operator; units placed along the national highway.
cambodia-240kw.outcome: Repeat order — the same customer bought again after running the first site.
cambodia-240kw.limits: One operator, one corridor. Continuous-downtime claims refer to the monsoon period observed, not to a multi-year availability study.
cambodia-240kw.source: Order and deployment record from the repeat customer.

romania-highway.site_context: Highway service areas for a leading Romanian CPO — our first deployment in Romania.
romania-highway.binding_constraint: AFIR-era compliance and approval sequencing: what stops a project is the permitting and evidence trail before energisation, not the hardware.
romania-highway.configuration: Vulco DC Series at 180 kW, dual-gun and three-gun configurations, at highway service areas.
romania-highway.commissioning: Entire go-live run by embedded Anari engineers rather than remote support.
romania-highway.outcome: First Romania deployment completed; the commissioning sequence became the template used for later EU sites.
romania-highway.limits: Narrative is a commissioning account, not a measured utilisation dataset. Site throughput is not published.

hot-climate.site_context: Public charging networks in the Middle East and an Israeli partner network, from 2025 onward.
hot-climate.binding_constraint: Peak summer: networks fail on the same point — sustained ambient heat above what a standard enclosure assumes.
hot-climate.configuration: 120–180 kW DC across an Israeli partner's network; 120 kW three-gun in Saudi Arabia; 160 kW in Jordan.
hot-climate.outcome: Rated power is held past 45 °C on the sites described; the failure mode seen elsewhere (cable/connector rather than power modules) is documented in our field report.
hot-climate.limits: Sample is small and operator-reported, not a failure-rate study. Treat it as a maintenance-priority hint, not a reliability claim.
hot-climate.source: Field observations; full method and limits in /data/findings-2026.

cold-climate.site_context: Commercial parking in northern/central Kazakhstan (minus 30 °C for weeks) and a Georgian charging network operator.
cold-climate.binding_constraint: Cold start: at sustained minus 30 °C a conventional cabinet does not simply run at reduced power — it may not start at all.
cold-climate.configuration: 6 × dual-gun 120 kW DC in Kazakhstan (12 connectors), ordered July 2026, in service August 2026; 120 kW and 180 kW dual-gun units in Georgia.
cold-climate.commissioning: Kazakhstan site in service August 2026; Georgia delivered to the country's second charging network operator.
cold-climate.outcome: Cold-start operation at minus 30 °C achieved on the Kazakhstan site.
cold-climate.limits: One winter season observed; no multi-year cold-soak data. Connector-level failures are not reported.
cold-climate.source: Deployment record; seasonal conditions from site.

off-grid-pv-ess.site_context: Industrial park in China with no usable grid connection for the required charging power.
off-grid-pv-ess.binding_constraint: No grid: the system has to generate, store and deliver energy on site, so storage sizing comes before charger selection.
off-grid-pv-ess.configuration: PV array mounted above the parking area + battery energy storage + 22 kW AC and 80/120 kW DC charging, designed as one off-grid system.
off-grid-pv-ess.commissioning: Off-grid architecture commissioned as a single system rather than three separate purchases.
off-grid-pv-ess.outcome: Site runs off-grid; storage capacity sets how many charging points can be energised at once.
off-grid-pv-ess.limits: Single industrial site; no published year-round yield data for the PV array. Economics depend on local tariffs and cannot be generalised.

emerging-markets.site_context: Ethiopia, Bulgaria and El Salvador — markets where policy or demand arrived before the infrastructure did.
emerging-markets.binding_constraint: Policy-first demand: the absence of infrastructure, not competition for share, is what decides whether a project can start.
emerging-markets.configuration: Ethiopia: 3 × dual-gun 180 kW DC (6 connectors, 540 kW) at one commercial site. Bulgaria: 4 × Castor cabinets. El Salvador: 40 kW dual-gun wallbox DC.
emerging-markets.commissioning: Commissioned in each market as an early deployment.
emerging-markets.outcome: Three early-market deployments delivered where networks did not yet exist.
emerging-markets.limits: Three separate single-site deployments; utilisation data is not published for any of them.
